# Video breakdown report: chenxi_ai_daihuo.mp4

> English translation of [report.md](report.md), the Markdown report rea-video generated for this video. Section order and content follow the tool output. Text recognized on screen (the "text track" lines, text on objects in the frame and the packaging-table text) is kept in the original Chinese, since that is what appears in the frame.

**Verdict**: mixed production: live footage 75% + AI-generated video 25% (for 100% of the duration the evidence for live vs. AI is insufficient, to be confirmed); overlays: styled text, text labels, graphic stickers, captions, title (composited in code / an editor); real material used: live video footage (43.1 s); references to prepare for a remake: product reference photos (4 shots); audio: voice + BGM at 114.8 BPM (library music) + 31 sound effects; editing and packaging: 300 captions, 4 styled-text items, 56 text labels, 29 sound effects timed to text / sticker entrances

- Duration 57.667 s · 1080×1920 · 30.0 fps · 9:16
- 21 shots, 2.75 s average; transitions: cut×20, start×1
- Confidence (duration-weighted): 70%; method: deterministic forensics fused with a vision model (VLM)
- VLM active (gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3.1-pro-preview-pc, gcp-gemini-3-pro-preview @ daydream88.fun); the agent (claude) visually reviewed 21 of 21 shots, merged into the verdict

## Remake plan

**6 AI shots → 6 generation units, 6 Seedance 2.5 calls; 15 live-action shots → 2 scenes, 4 camera setups**

- The default engine, Seedance 2.0 (including Mini / Fast), cannot produce several shots in one call; with it you would generate the 6 shots one by one. This plan assumes Seedance 2.5 (≤30 s per call, multi-shot in one call): 6 calls in total
- Grouping rules: AI shots in the same set joined by hard cuts are merged into one generation (S01); ≤30 s per call; consecutive hard cuts inside a unit should stay ≤8 s, at most 10 s (S06); split at dissolves / fades and set changes (S03)
- Audio: the model can generate action sound effects and ambience along with the picture; voice-over is better done as separate TTS and mixed in, so you can change the script and timing

### Shooting sessions

Shoot all the shots of one scene before moving to the next; within a scene shoot the wider sizes first, then the close-ups, so the lighting need not be reset. Leave about 1 s of handle at each end of every take.

**S1**: shots #1, #5, #6, #7, #8, #9 (26.93 s in the cut); a woman with glasses delivers a voice-over explanation in a bright interior, raising one hand in an emphasis gesture, fixed close-up setup, even diffused light from above.
- Lighting: backlit / background brighter than the subject, frontal (from the camera direction, both sides of the subject equally bright), about 1.1:1 (0.1 stops), neutral (about 5000K)
- Setup close-up · moving (gimbal / handheld pan) · pan / track: shot #1, 1.93 s in the cut, suggested take 3.9 s
- Setup close-up · fixed (tripod / stand / on a table) · static: shots #5, #6, #7, #8, #9, 25.0 s in the cut, suggested take 35.0 s

**S2**: shots #10, #11, #12, #13, #14, #15, #16, #17, #18 (16.2 s in the cut); a close-up of a phone screen showing the Seedance 2.0 app; a hand holding a stylus taps an orange-haired girl avatar icon on the screen.
- Lighting: frontal soft light (flat), frontal (from the camera direction, both sides of the subject equally bright), about 1.0:1 (0.1 stops), neutral (about 5000K)
- Setup close-up · fixed (tripod / stand / on a table) · static: shots #10, #11, #12, #14, #16, #17, #18, 14.47 s in the cut, suggested take 28.5 s

- Framing: shot size close-up (phone screen) 86%, close-up (head and shoulders) 9%, close-up 4%; angle slightly high (phone standing / tilted on the desk, camera from front above); subject is the sharpest region of the frame (no face, shot size is an estimate)
- Camera: fixed (tripod / stand / on a table) 92%, moving (gimbal / handheld pan) 8%; common move pan / track
- Lighting: frontal soft light (flat). Key frontal (from the camera direction, both sides of the subject equally bright), level with the subject; contrast ratio about 1.1:1 (0.2 stops); soft light (wide shadow transition); neutral color temperature (about 5000K); background clearly blurred (shallow depth of field / portrait mode)
- Grade: natural (close to source); normal saturation, normal contrast, normal blacks, neutral overall
- Editing: 20.8 cuts per minute, 2.88 s average live-action shot; 5 setups / scenes; 0 jump cuts on the same setup, 4 punch-in cuts; inserts (screenshots / screen recordings / cards / stock) 25%; 31% of cuts land on speech pauses
- Form: tabletop / product shooting (desk shot) (face as subject 4%, objects / hands as subject 96%, handheld 9%); visual judgment: voice-over tutorial + live phone-screen demo + AI-generated product-video segments (the creator's on-camera footage used as subject reference)

**Live-action shooting plan**

1. Form: tabletop / product shooting
2. Framing: mainly close-up (phone screen), slightly high angle (phone standing / tilted on the desk, camera from front above)
3. Camera: fixed (tripod / stand / on a table) 92%, moving (gimbal / handheld pan) 8%; common move pan / track
4. Lighting: frontal soft light (flat): a large source from the camera direction, almost no shadows on the subject: face a window, use a ring light, or put a large softbox behind the camera
5. Editing: 20.8 cuts per minute, 2.88 s average live-action shot; 5 setups / scenes; 0 jump cuts on the same setup, 4 punch-in cuts; inserts (screenshots / screen recordings / cards / stock) 25%; 31% of cuts land on speech pauses

Gear:
- One large soft light directly above the desk / behind the camera (or two, symmetric at 45° left and right)
- A white desktop or a white card bounce makes the shadows lighter
- Note: background clearly blurred (shallow depth of field / portrait mode)

- **Background music**: library music (existing_library 72%, popular_song 18%, ai_generated 10%)
  - The music is a bed under the picture: for an ordinary video the bed is most likely from a library (prior)
  - VLM listening judgment: library music
  - The music is cut off hard at the end (the video ends while it is still at full volume): typical of an excerpt from an existing track
  - How to confirm: on the Douyin / Xiaohongshu page check the music tag: a song title → existing track; "original sound by @author" → uploaded by the author (for music videos this is usually an AI song)
  - How to confirm: run Soda Music / QQ Music song recognition or ACRCloud: a hit means an existing song
  - How to confirm: listen: AI songs often have slurred diction, thin metallic highs and lyrics that track the picture closely; library beds are mostly instrumental, standard structure, cut off or faded at the end
- **Voice**: human recording (human_recording 83%, tts 13%, ai_video_native 4%)
  - VLM judged it a human voice
  - 75% of the picture is live footage: the voice is most likely sync sound or a human voice-over
- **Sound effects**: live sync sound (live_sync 65%, library_editor 24%, ai_native 12%)
  - The picture is mostly live footage: the ambience is most likely sync sound
- Per-segment native-audio check: background change 6.8 dB at cuts, 8.5 dB within shots (ratio 0.79) → the sound runs continuously across cuts; it was laid over the whole cut in post

**Audio remake plan**

- voice (A01-narration): human voice-over / dialogue, young female, standard Mandarin, the warm, knowledgeable tone of a tutorial creator, medium-fast pace, crisp and clear, typical short-video teaching delivery → capsule-cinema DoubaoTTSTool / UniversalTTSTool (or a MiniMax cloned voice); use duration-controlled TTS (A02) when you must fit the original timing
- music (A03-music): upbeat, lively tech-tutorial music, switching to a warm, relaxed lifestyle bed for the finished-video section in the second half; relaxed, everyday, soothing; 114.8 BPM; F major → the original leans library: search a library by BPM / mood / key, or generate a royalty-free track in a similar style with AI
- sfx (A04-sfx): 3 effects → place them at the listed time points: capsule-cinema SoundEffectsTool / an effects library, or synthesize them procedurally like the plush recipe (pitch matched to the BGM key)
- ambience (A04-sfx): quiet indoor ambience → ambience stock or a video-to-audio model
- Mix: the voice-over sits clearly in front, BGM at a moderate level as a bed only, and in the finished-video section the background sound blends naturally into the product video's own voice

## Structure and copy (VLM)

- Summary: a tutorial on using Doubao to refine prompts and Jimeng AI to generate a product video of everyday goods with a real-looking presenter on camera.
- Form: explainer; hook: opens with the creator on camera saying "每天分享一个AI制作方法" ("one AI production method a day"), then cuts straight to an extremely realistic AI-generated ceramic-mug product video with a real-looking presenter, grabbing the attention of e-commerce creators.
- Narration: human, young female, standard Mandarin, the warm knowledgeable tone of a tutorial creator; music: upbeat, lively tech-tutorial music, switching to a warm, relaxed lifestyle bed for the finished video in the second half; captions: bold sans-serif centered at the bottom, bright yellow combined with white, black outline
- Overall judgment: live voice-over explanation combined with hands-on recording; the core showcase is the AI-generated product video; a typical low-cost, high-utility digital / AI short-video tutorial.
  - 0.0–1.93 s · intro and topic teaser · "One AI production method a day"
  - 1.93–6.63 s · quick preview of the finished result · "Today I'll show you how to make a product video of everyday goods with a real person on camera; let me demonstrate with this mug"
  - 6.63–11.93 s · preparation: product reference photos · "Save the photos of the mug you want to sell; save a few of them"
  - 11.93–32.93 s · step 1: generate shot-by-shot product-video prompts with Doubao · "Open the AI tool, add the product photos we saved, paste in the prompt we just prepared... tap send, and the prompts come right out; copy the one you like"
  - 32.93–48.0 s · step 2: generate the product video in Jimeng / Seedance · "Go to this screen, choose the on-camera footage I recorded in advance, paste the prompt we just copied, tap the image button below, import our two mug photos, then tap send; in Drafts you can see the generation progress"
  - 48.0–58.0 s · final result and wrap-up · "Let's look at the result: the scene is realistic, doesn't it draw you in? (line from the generated video: hot cocoa is so comforting, perfect whether for yourself or as a gift for a friend)"
